svg.title: Making room
svg.desc: Disk full. Of what, nobody knows, so it measures before anything is deleted. Four steps: ask Windows first (Settings, System, Storage); if still unclear, a map from a guest tool, for looking; free one thing, with your yes, item by item; measure again and stop when there is room. A disk map fills in: videos 60 GB, old Windows 25 GB, restore points 12 GB, downloads 9 GB, and three padlocked grey blocks, WinSxS, Installer and drivers. The pointer heads for WinSxS and gets a stamp: not by hand. The videos are moved, copy checked first, and free space goes from 3 GB to 63 GB. Illustrative figures.
